title: Red cards and skin tone
subtitle: 29 research teams. Same data. Opposite answers.
question: Are soccer referees more likely to give red cards to dark-skin-toned players than to light-skin-toned players?

decision_rule.metric: odds ratio of a red card per game, dark vs light skin tone

reference.label: Team 1: Ordinary least squares with robust standard errors, logistic regression
Team 2: Linear probability model, logistic regression
Team 3: Multilevel Binomial Logistic Regression using bayesian inference
Team 8: Negative binomial regression with a log link analysis
Team 9: Generalized linear mixed effects models with a logit link function
Team 10: Multilevel regression and logistic regression
Team 14: Weighted least squares regression with referee fixed-effects and clustered standard errors
Team 20: Cross-classified multilevel negative binomial model
Team 26: Three-level hierarchical generalized linear modeling with Poisson sampling
Team 30: Clustered robust binomial logistic regression
Team 32: Generalized linear models for binary data

story: Twenty-nine teams analysed this dataset and disagreed on whether referees card dark-skinned players more. The default analysis gives OR 1.34 (95% CI 1.13 to 1.58): bias detected. No single analytic choice reverses that and no pair does; it takes three together, such as a full covariate set, frequent referees only and player-clustered errors, to land on no clear evidence (OR 1.20 to 1.25). The one single flip that existed, restricting to low-bias referees, is not defensible.

column_notes.games: number of games the player and this referee shared (one row per player-referee dyad); it is not the player's total games
column_notes.redCards: number of red cards the referee gave this player across their shared games
column_notes.yellowCards: number of yellow cards the referee gave this player across their shared games
column_notes.yellowReds: number of second yellow cards (leading to a red) the referee gave this player across their shared games
column_notes.rater1: skin tone of the player rated by rater 1 from the photo, 0 very light to 1 very dark
column_notes.rater2: skin tone of the player rated by rater 2 from the photo, 0 very light to 1 very dark
column_notes.leagueCountry: country of the league the player plays in
column_notes.meanIAT: mean implicit-bias (race IAT) score of the referee's country of origin
column_notes.meanExp: mean explicit-bias score of the referee's country of origin
